interpretation: The read test expected a null/unknown outcome, but the actual Studionet client threw ResourceNotFoundRpcError for this exact nonexistent hash. Its unsuccessful test output is preserved; this is not evidence of another transaction or corrupt recovery.
ui_observation: The earlier zero-hash browser attempt showed a generic connection-verification error and retained the original hash; its underlying RPC response was not independently captured. A separate contemporaneous lookup of the real hash had a DNS failure.

source_finding.description: Resource-not-found errors fall through to the generic connection message. The wording should distinguish an unrecognized transaction hash without exposing raw RPC calldata.
